about_the_game:
Break into Raven’s Rest National Park, once a quiet landmark—now sealed off and overrun by the infected remains of a failed government experiment.

Play as Rosanna Vale, a confident but reckless thief hired to steal a classified sample from a secret Department of Energy lab hidden beneath the park. What begins as an easy payday spirals into a fight for survival when the experiment’s true nature turns out to be more than she bargained for.

Explore the park’s haunted ruins, uncover the truth behind the E213 infection, and fight your way out before you become the next victim.

---

Key Features

Environmental Horror

Ravens Rest focuses on environmental storytelling, rather than jump-scare focused gameplay.

Tense survival gameplay

Conserve ammo, manage light, and use the environment to avoid or outsmart the infected that roam the park.

Puzzles shape the world

Restore power, reroute pressure valves, and activate long-dead systems to reach the hidden lab beneath the mountains.

---

The Story

Rosanna thought it would be simple: sneak into the park, grab a sample, get paid.

But Raven’s Rest hides a secret. Years ago, a research team discovered a fungal organism deep in its caves—something capable of mimicking human consciousness. When the lab went silent, the government sealed the area.

Now, the dead walk the park trails, and the entire park has become corrupted

Each section of the park—the visitors’ center, the flooded swamp, the mountain trails, and the underground bunker—unfolds another layer of the mystery.

By the time she reaches the lab, Rosanna will have to decide how far she’s willing to go to escape… and what she’ll leave behind.

---

About the game:

* Single-player survival horror experience

* First-person exploration with puzzle and stealth elements

* Fully voice-acted dialogue and environmental storytelling
